content.short: Social crypto wallet available on Telegram, iOS, Android and Chrome, backed by Polychain.
content.description: Tomo aims to make self-custody wallets feel as easy as a social app. Users set up a wallet instantly with social accounts and can trade and earn from a lightweight Telegram bot, a mobile app or a Chrome extension across many chains. Developers can use the Tomo Connect SDK to add wallet connections to their own apps.
content.meta: Tomo is a multichain social wallet with instant social-login setup on Telegram, mobile and Chrome, plus a developer SDK.
content.pageTitle: Tomo - Web3 Wallets - Lancers Web3 Explorer
